intent: Leave the lane, descend into the stream valley, approach the old footbridge, explore above and below it, and enter riverside woodland. Expert redesign: bridge counterweights and falling support shoes.

sections.name: The country lane
sections.lesson: Follow the low lane towards the water. Follow the weight as it swings away.
